name: Land a finished build
description: Land a finished build the way vps build_land does: merge main into its branch, rerun its checks, push to main, settle bookkeeping clashes (THREADS, STATUS, builds store, trackers) and report code clashes without guessing.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: Checks to rerun
inputs.default: the build's own tests + node framework/cli/tracker.mjs --check

data.brief:
Land branch {{branch}} (build {{build}}).
1. git fetch origin; merge origin/main into {{branch}} (never rebase, never force).
2. Bookkeeping clashes (_claude/THREADS.md, _claude/memory/STATUS.md, _claude/builds/, tracker.json, catalogs): keep both sides' lines, then regenerate generated files (tracker.mjs).
3. Code clashes: do NOT resolve by guessing. Abort, list the files and both sides' intent in the report, status blocked.
4. Rerun {{checks}}. All green: git push origin HEAD:main. Red: report, do not push.
Report what landed (commit), what clashed and what still needs a person.
